recap.text: Osvaldo says he is about to finish, and Carl cannot know the Royal Court's place, so he looks at Donut, who nods. He finds the detonator under Primed in his explosives menu, whispers forgive me, friends, and clicks Detonate, eliminating Team Free Love through the death of both racers. Samantha had distracted the bugbears while Carl, in Oozy Form, swapped one of their peach beers for a drilled-out one fitted with a hidden explosive.

beats.headline: Forgive me, friends
beats.text: Osvaldo says he is about to cross the finish line, and Carl cannot know what place the Royal Court is in. He looks at Donut, and she nods. He finds the detonator under Primed in his explosives menu, whispers forgive me, friends, and clicks Detonate. Team Free Love is eliminated due to the death of both racers. Earlier, Samantha distracted the bugbears while Carl, in Oozy Form, swapped one of the peach beers in their cooler for the one they had given him, drilled out and fitted with a hidden explosive. The cooler teleports back into their van after every race.
beats.gist: Carl detonates the hidden beer-can bomb planted in the Royal Court's cooler, eliminating Team Free Love.
